description:
£150 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to present this spacious six-bedroom student property on Buston Terrace, in the popular area of Jesmond.

Furnished to a high standard, the property offers six generous double bedrooms, two bathrooms and a separate WC, making it ideal for a group of students. The property also boasts a large open-plan kitchen, lounge and dining area, providing the perfect space for socialising, alongside a private rear yard and on-street parking.

Ideally located close to Newcastle City Centre, with a variety of cafés, takeaways and local amenities nearby, this property offers an excellent base for student living.

To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team.
